newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - W W Grainger rating upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - W W Grainger rating upped.

text.p: -- Barrington Research Associates Inc said Tuesday it raised its rating for W.W. Grainger Inc to 2-buy from 3-hold to reflect the company's upcoming ability to cash in on its Acklands purchase last December and a recent decline in the stock price, representing a buying opportunity.

-- Barrington said the company's recently reported first-quarter earnings of $1.03 a share apparently was a shock to Wall Street, although the figure was just $0.01 below Barrington's estimate for the period.

-- Barrington also raised its earnings estimates for 1997 to $4.40 from $4.28 because of a share buyback program and the diminishing effects of integration expenses from the Acklands buy in the second half of the year.
-- Grainger provides maintenance, repair and operating supplies to several industries.
-- Its shares were up 1-1/4 Tuesday at 74-1/2.
